guideIntroText: The business portal brings credits, modules and daily actions into one calm workspace.
guideIntegrationsText: Supabase stores business data, Resend sends notifications and Stripe confirms credit purchases securely.
guideModulesText: Enable, open and pin tools from the modules tab. Overview stays focused on personal shortcuts.
guideSettingsText: Settings manage access, Supabase Auth, low-credit alerts, public page design and payment instructions.
guideDoneText: Finish this guide when the main setup is clear. The card disappears from this browser.
modulesIntro: Enable, open and pin the tools this workspace uses most often.
creditsLowHelp: Public booking and rent are paused below 5 available credits.
creditsReadyHelp: Booking, rent and email actions can continue normally.
publicLandingLanguageHelp: Public landing is fixed to this language. Workspace users choose their own private UI language.
paletteHelp: Applied across the public page and private workspace. Contrast checks help meet WCAG 2.2 readability expectations.
endHelp: This removes the active owner, integrations, access list and enabled resources from this workspace. Use this only when the business no longer wants to manage this portal.
